samples.summary: Todo checklist lists work as pending ([ ] unchecked) that already exists in the codebase, and the paired lessons file's factual claim about table-renderer.ts is stale/inaccurate relative to the actual current code.
samples.evidence: The todo lists unchecked steps: 'Add drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLine to paint-layout.ts', 'Use it in drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLayout', 'Use it in drawInlineRunBackgroundsForPage', 'Use it in table-renderer.ts's inline-background sweep', and 'Stop paintLayout double-painting backgrounds' — but these are all already implemented in the current tree: packages/docs/src/view/paint-layout.ts already exports drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLine (used by both drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLayout at line 306 and drawInlineRunBackgroundsForPage at line 349), paintLayout already gates its background pass behind skipRunBackgrounds (paint-layout.ts:110-121) and documents at lines 135-139 that renderRun always skips its own fill to avoid double-painting, and packages/docs/src/view/table-renderer.ts:223-230 already calls drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLine per line. This also contradicts the companion lessons file's claim ('table-renderer.ts rounded neither and was already continuous') implying table-renderer.ts predates/lacks the coalescing helper — it already uses the shared coalescing helper. A future contributor picking up this 'active' task could be misled into re-implementing, or second-guessing, code that already works this way.
